title: The Crown Where Canopy Reaches Beyond Record

features.name: the uppermost junction
features.desc-on-touch: Where leaf-traces cross circuit pathways. The canopy's growth reads as signal here. You can feel the data moving through living wood.

features.name: the emergence itself
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe canopy apex, the exact point where recording ends and growth continues unseen. The structure draws itself as it rises.

features.name: branching logic
features.desc-on-touch: Pathways that split like twigs. Each branch carries a copy of the canopy's understanding of itself. The tree reads as it grows.

features.name: light interpreted
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph-plate receiving sunlight as data. The canopy learns through light as the circuit reads through current.

features.name: unrecorded growth
features.desc-on-touch: The space above the board, beyond reach of any measuring device. The canopy grows here in the archive's own blindness.

inscription: here the archive reads what it cannot write

file.name: Canopy_Crown_Growth_Increment_Study_1997_2024.txt
file.note: Each year a measurement. Each year more space between recorded and actual. The gap itself is the continuation.
